data.name: Yash
data.gender_notes: Yash is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit yaśas, 'fame, glory, splendour'. Its root is Sanskrit yaś (यश्). A classical Sanskrit term for fame and glory. Yash is a Sanskrit name meaning “Fame; glory; success”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Yash expresses “Fame; glory; success”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit yaśas, 'fame, glory, splendour'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yash total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
